header.description: A comprehensive system for every phase of construction, ensuring perfect results from the structure to the last detail.

fase1.title: Metal Framing
fase1.subtitle: "The skeleton of construction"
fase1.desc: Lightweight structural systems designed to support loads and resist stress.
fase1.li1: Framing of walls and room divisions.
fase1.li3: Bulkheads for lights and dropped ceilings.
fase1.li4: Laser leveling so everything is straight.

fase2.title: Drywall Installation
fase2.subtitle: "The core of the design"
fase2.desc: Integration of specialized panels depending on the area, optimizing execution times with a clean and modular assembly system.

fase3.title: Finishes and Detailing
fase3.subtitle: "The skin of the structure"
fase3.desc: Treatment of joints and surfaces designed for grazing lighting and luxury finishes where imperfections have no place.
fase3.li2Desc: Standard smooth finish for matte or satin paint.
fase3.li3Desc: Full skim coat for maximum quality (Mirror effect).
